امتعضتا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضَتَا (imtaʕaḍatā) /im.ta.ʕa.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضَتَا (umtuʕiḍatā) /um.tu.ʕi.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
